description.la: De agone christiano. Textus Latinus secundum editionem Maurinorum.
description.en-US: On the Christian Struggle (396), by St. Augustine of Hippo. Latin text of the Maurist edition; no public-domain English translation has been imported yet.
description.pt-BR: O combate cristão (396), de Santo Agostinho de Hipona. Texto latino da edição dos Maurinos.

sources.edition: Maurist text (Benedictines of Saint-Maur, 1679-1700) as printed in Migne, Patrologia Latina, on augustinus.it (Corpus Augustinianum Gissense / NBA Latin pages)
sources.description: Latin pages agone_cristiano of augustinus.it, one page per book, long pages split at chapter boundaries. The Italian NBA headings, summaries and biblical-reference notes are dropped; section numbers and italicised quotations are kept. Raw mirror in research/sourcing/augustine-latin/raw.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 4th-5th-century work in the Maurist edition (1679-1700, Migne 1841-49), long public domain.

sources.edition: Seventeen Short Treatises of S. Augustine, Bishop of Hippo, translated with notes and indices (Library of the Fathers, vol. 22; Oxford: John Henry Parker; London: Rivington, 1847), tr. C. L. Cornish.
sources.description: Internet Archive scan, read from the _djvu.xml word coordinates (research/sourcing/_scripts/aug_lf.py): marginal Scripture references, running heads, the editor’s introduction, and the small-type notes are dropped, so the text is the translation alone with the Benedictine section numbers. OCR is uncorrected beyond common letter confusions; stray fragments of marginal references remain in a few lines.
sources.tierEvidence: Published 1847 (translator d. 19th c.); long public domain.
